_comment: Constraint rules - run AFTER the Pair step.
Every object in the set is checked for an attribute called 'Con'. Whatever node
is connected to it becomes the driver, and a parentConstraint is built so the
Measured: re-running with the SAME driver is idempotent, but a DIFFERENT driver
silently adds a second target to the existing constraint. So the tool refuses to
touch an object that already has a parentConstraint and says so.
2026-08-31: the set had been spelled 'C04_pose_objects' (no 'j') - the user
confirmed it was a typo and it now reads 'C04_pose_objects'.
